title: nutmeg roasted uruguayan potatoes hash
description: a delicious and flavorful roasted uruguayan potatoes hash recipe with a unique nutmeg touch and a sprinkle of fresh cilantro. this recipe is perfect for a quick weeknight dinner or a weekend brunch.

ingredients.name: large potatoes
ingredients.notes: choose high-starch potatoes for the fluffiest hash

instructions: preheat the oven to 425 degrees fahrenheit.
cut the potatoes into 1-inch cubes and place them in a bowl.
drizzle the potatoes with olive oil and sprinkle with salt, pepper, and a pinch of nutmeg.
toss the potatoes to coat evenly and spread them on a baking sheet in a single layer.
roast the potatoes in the preheated oven for 20-25 minutes, or until they are tender and lightly browned.
while the potatoes are roasting, thinly slice 1/4 cup of red onion and 1/4 cup of fresh cilantro.
remove the potatoes from the oven and let them cool slightly.
fluff the potatoes with a fork to create a light and airy texture.
transfer the potatoes to a serving dish and top with the sliced red onion and cilantro.
serve the nutmeg roasted uruguayan potatoes hash hot, garnished with additional cilantro if desired.
